title: GWZiehory Indoor Tabletop Fountain with Light and Natural Waterfall Sounds | Water Fountain for Desktop, Spa and Home Décor, 4-Tier Small Desktop Fountain for Leisure and Relax Zen Meditation

videos.creator: Seller
videos.description: • A product overview video showcasing an indoor tabletop water fountain ornament, highlighting its multi-tiered rock formation design, flowing water cascading down stacked stone levels, and a color-changing LED light at the base that cycles through blue, green, and purple. • The LED-lit water basin creates an ambient glow effect, and the fountain is shown from multiple close-up angles to emphasize the realistic rock texture and the movement of water over each tier. • Nature footage of a mossy forest floor and flowing woodland streams is included to evoke the calming, natural atmosphere the fountain is designed to bring indoors, reinforcing the "purification of the mind" theme shown in the title card.
